classes.name: Warrior
classes.desc: Builds Rage by hitting and being hit. Spend it on brutal strikes.

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.desc: Doubles Rage gain and unlocks Reckless Frenzy.

subclasses.name: Guardian
subclasses.desc: Parries melee blows and unlocks Shield Wall.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.desc: Hide, strike from the shadows, and regenerate Energy every turn.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.desc: Sneak attacks are devastating. Unlocks Assassinate.

subclasses.name: Duelist
subclasses.desc: Riposte: parry and punish. Unlocks Parry Stance.

classes.name: Mage
classes.desc: Fragile but lethal. Spells exploit the battlefield: fire ignites oil, lightning arcs through water.

subclasses.name: Pyromancer
subclasses.desc: Fire spells burn longer. Unlocks Inferno.

subclasses.name: Cryomancer
subclasses.desc: Cold spells freeze. Unlocks Deep Freeze.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.desc: Faith Charges fuel heals and holy wrath. Regain a charge every other round.

subclasses.name: Lifeweaver
subclasses.desc: Heals are stronger. Unlocks Mass Heal.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.desc: Mark prey and unload from range. Stamina refills each turn.

subclasses.name: Beastmaster
subclasses.desc: Summons a spirit wolf. Unlocks Call Wolf.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.desc: Smite with Holy Charges, protect allies, heal with a touch.

subclasses.name: Oathkeeper
subclasses.desc: Parry and protect. Unlocks Aura of Protection.

feats.name: Bulwark
feats.desc: +1 AC and you may Parry once per round (reaction).

feats.name: Open Wounds
feats.desc: Slashing and piercing hits have a 35% chance to cause Bleeding.

feats.name: Heavy Hitter
feats.desc: Two-handed weapons deal +3 damage and reroll damage 1s.

feats.name: Bloodthirst
feats.desc: Heal 10% of all damage you deal.

feats.name: Protector
feats.desc: When an ally is hit, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d6.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.desc: Once per battle, reroll a missed attack that was within 3 of hitting.

feats.name: Second Wind
feats.desc: Bonus action, once per battle: heal 1d10 + level.

feats.name: Shield Master
feats.desc: Defend grants +3 extra AC and Shove becomes a bonus action.

feats.name: Alchemist
feats.desc: Potions heal 50% more and cost no bonus action.

feats.name: Arcane Surge
feats.desc: Spell damage +3 and spells critical on 19-20.

feats.name: Iron Will
feats.desc: Advantage on saving throws and +2 max HP per level.

feats.name: Light Fingers
feats.desc: +3 on theft checks; failures are less noticed.
